incident-bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool resv-prod-us-west1 at 99% GPU utilization for 7m; queue depth 620 -> growth rate +12%/m. Throttling spikes observed. Paging oncall.

sarah (oncall): I'm on it. grabbing logs and runbook. paging infra and runtime.

kevin (infra): seeing autoscaler reported 'scale_limit_reached' for pool resv-prod-us-west1. manual scale attempts hit quota. attaching recent autoscaler log snippet.

kevin (infra): ```
[2026-03-15T02:11:04Z] autoscaler: pool=resv-prod-us-west1 desired=120 actual=120 limit=120 reason=quota_hit
[2026-03-15T02:11:05Z] queue: depth=620 inflight=480 avg_latency=780ms
```

sarah (oncall): thanks. can we identify noisy tenants? metrics show a few tenants at 3-4x baseline token/sec.

dmitri (sre): running tenant heatmap now. initial top noisy: CedarAI (tenant_id=cda-73), nova-ml (nml-11), test-qa (tqa-9). CedarAI accounts for ~45% of active GPU slots in the pool.

kate (eng-runtime): runtime note: when pool is at >95%, our eviction fallback isn't triggering because reservation affinity is honored for reserved tenants. that prevents preemption of CedarAI jobs. can we temporarily relax affinity for 20m?

lia (acct-eng): CedarAI is an enterprise reserved customer. relaxing affinity will impact their SLA. we need approval before preempting. contacting account manager now.

mike (product): customer impact: CedarAI heavy jobs are batch retrains not latency-critical but they have reserved capacity contract. other customers are seeing throttled inference and 500s. we need a mitigation that preserves customer SLAs where possible.

sarah (oncall): mitigation plan proposal: 1) open temporary burst pool with spare spot capacity (if available) 2) force-evict non-reserved low-priority tasks (test-qa) 3) request short-lived quota increase from infra 4) notify CedarAI with ETA and workaround. any objections?

kevin (infra): tried to spin burst; cloud quota blocked by subscription limit. I can request emergency quota bump but typical turnaround 10-20m. requesting now.

kevin (infra): ```
gcloud compute instance-templates create burst-rt-1 --machine-type a2-highgpu-1g --region us-west1
Request submitted: quotaIncreaseId=qi-8821 status=pending
```

dmitri (sre): I'm starting graceful cancel on test-qa and low-priority queues; will drain nodes and free ~18 GPUs in 4-6m. kicking off now.

deploy-bot: STATE CHANGE: resv-pool-eviction-policy set to 'allow-preemptible-lowprio' by dmitri at 02:18:21Z.

sarah (oncall): lia, any update from acct? need CedarAI consent for affinity relax.

lia (acct-eng): CedarAI account team responded: they can tolerate short eviction of non-critical batch jobs for 30m if we guarantee no data loss and quick restart. verbal ok, formal notice being drafted.

kate (eng-runtime): implementing temporary affinity override for non-core reserved groups now. this will allow us to preempt CedarAI batch slots that are marked as low-priority while keeping their pinned production models. pushing config:

kate (eng-runtime): ```yaml
# temporary override - 20m window
pool: resv-prod-us-west1
affinity_override:
  target: reserved:lowprio
  action: preempt
  ttl: 20m
```

sarah (oncall): executing preempt on low-prio reserved jobs. please monitor queue.

kevin (infra): quota bump approved for +24 GPUs; provisioning started. ETA 8m.

sarah (oncall): queue depth dropping -> 620 -> 410 in 5m. latency trending down.

dmitri (sre): freed ~22 GPUs from low-prio drains. combined with quota bump and burst nodes we'll be ~+44 GPUs. should stabilize.

mike (product): customer comms: Lia please send short note to CedarAI outlining actions + expected window and confirm any job restarts will be non-destructive. keep tone: we prioritized their SLA.

lia (acct-eng): sending now. DMed copy to @sarah.

incident-bot: RESOLVE: Pool resv-prod-us-west1 utilization normalized to 62% at 02:48:54Z. Auto-scaler resumed normal operations. Root cause: multiple large batch jobs by CedarAI combined with autoscaler quota ceiling.

sarah (oncall): Post-incident actions: 1) follow-up with CedarAI to schedule dedicated burst allowance or change reservation profiles 2) engineering to add early-warning alert for reservation-affinity saturation at 85% 3) autoscaler should surface quota limit as a pager next time (not just logs) 4) runbook update to include affinity override playbook. assigning owners.

kevin (infra): I'll own autoscaler pager change.

kate (eng-runtime): I'll add affinity override runbook and add a short script to toggle safely.

dmitri (sre): I'll prepare a postmortem draft with timeline, impact, and metrics. expected publish in 48h.

mike (product): track customer impact: CedarAI saw ~12 min slowdown for non-prod retrains, other tenants had transient 500s for 9-14m. include in comms.

lia (acct-eng): CedarAI replied appreciating the quick coordination. they requested proactive quota plan; scheduling SG with them next week. :thumbsup:

sarah (oncall): closing thread. good work team. :tada:
